entries.title: Anomalocaris canadensis — ROM Burgess Shale
entries.supports: Flattened flexible swimming body, paired frontal appendages and stalked eyes, lateral swimming flaps, ventral mouth and three pairs of upturned tail blades. Oral cone has three broad radial plates, not the older Peytoia fourfold concept; microteeth/spines simplified.
